title: Applause Plush Peanuts Woodstock w Tag Stuffed Animal Toy 6” EXC Yellow Red Bow
descriptionText: The Applause Plush Peanuts Woodstock stuffed animal toy is a 6-inch yellow plush toy featuring the beloved character Woodstock from the Peanuts franchise. This cuddly stuffed toy is perfect for fans of the Peanuts TV show and movie, with its mini bird design and red bow accent. Made from plush material, this toy is a great addition to any collection of Peanuts memorabilia, bringing the charming and nostalgic world of Charlie Brown and his friends to life.
